Lumilens is an optical connectivity company building the interconnect engines that link GPUs together inside AI clusters. The company spans the full stack — silicon photonics, mixed-signal ICs, lasers, packaging, and manufacturing — starting with pluggable transceivers and building toward next-generation NPO and CPO architectures as scale-up connectivity moves from copper to optical.

We first partnered for their Series C in 2026.

Founders Ankur Singla, Ritesh Kapahi, Samuel Liu

Location San Francisco, CA

Website [lumilens.com](https://lumilens.com/)

Stage Invested Series C or Later
